Account control

Remove access.
Delete your data.

Account permissions, local records, and uploaded videos are separate. Use the steps below for the parts you want removed.

1. Stop new uploads

Use /pause in the private Telegram bot. Existing transfers may continue. The operator can stop the service completely if necessary.

2. Revoke connected-app access

For YouTube, open Google account permissions and remove the authorization for the upload app. For TikTok, remove Level13 Publisher from the connected apps in your account’s security or app-permission settings.

3. Request local deletion

Email level13.alrowads@gmail.com with the subject “Level13 Publisher data deletion.” Specify the connected account and whether you want credentials, local media, queue history, or all service data removed. Never send passwords, access tokens, or refresh tokens. The operator may ask for ownership verification.

This is an operator-handled request; this page does not automatically delete data. Local deletion does not delete the original Telegram message, platform drafts, published videos, or copies retained separately by platform providers.

4. Remove destination copies

Delete YouTube videos in YouTube Studio. Remove TikTok drafts or posts in TikTok, and Telegram messages in Telegram. Consult each platform’s controls for further account-data deletion.
